text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen, the year-end grand 
showdown where the powerhouses of both the 
Classic and Senior Years assemble.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the paddock, Maruzensky was approached 
by an Umamusume who had previously 
withdrawn from a race against her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Captivated by Maruzensky's running up to 
now, she revealed her heartfelt wish to 
run in the same race with her again 
someday.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking those feelings fully to heart, 
Maruzensky headed to the race to show a 
back that would make her want to chase 
after her even more.
